t: The death of Pasquale Falco, 1 October 1834
c: Arienzo civil death register 1834, page 236, act no. 69 (Archivio di Stato di Caserta, via Antenati). Names him husband of Chiara Rivetti and son of the late Matteo Falco and the late Francesca Crisci. Found by reading the volume line by line.
cite: Arienzo, Stato civile della restaurazione, Morti 1834, atto 69, p. 236 — Archivio di Stato di Caserta (Antenati an_ua14336, img 43)

c: Arienzo civil death register 1833, act no. 16. Son of Vincenzo Falco and Andreana Crisci, of strada Camellara. His grandfather Pasquale was still alive; a second child of the same name would be born and die in December 1834.
cite: Arienzo, Stato civile della restaurazione, Morti 1833, atto 16 — Archivio di Stato di Caserta (Antenati an_ua14335, img 9)

c: Act no. 32. She was born about 1762, five years before Pasquale, and her father was a different Michele Falco, married to Vincenza Esposito. The record establishes a second peasant Falco household at Arienzo in the founding generation.
cite: Arienzo, Stato civile della restaurazione, Morti 1832, atto 32 — Archivio di Stato di Caserta (Antenati an_ua14334, img 20)

c: Act no. 80, page 145. Daughter of Francesco Falco and Raffaela Falco, of strada Camellara — a Falco married to a Falco. Both declarants were neighbours from the same street.
cite: Arienzo, Stato civile della restaurazione, Morti 1832, atto 80, p. 145 — Archivio di Stato di Caserta (Antenati an_ua14334, img 48)

t: The reverse of the certificate — an inscription of 1948
c: The back of a family document, inscribed «li 14 Dicembre 1948 — Giordano Angelo». Who Giordano Angelo was, and what he had to do with this family, is not established. Recorded because it is written on one of the family's own papers.
cite: Family papers, from the family's own scans.

t: Croce al Merito di Guerra — Angelo Zampiello, 1938
c: Ministero dell'Africa Italiana. The War Merit Cross, conferred by decree of 14 September 1938 on «all'operaio ZAMPIELLO ANGELO di Tommaso» — the workman Angelo Zampiello, son of Tommaso. The decree cited extends the cross to personnel who took part in military operations in East Africa from 3 October 1935, the day Italy invaded Ethiopia. Order number 18745; Rome, 24 September 1938, Anno XVI.
cite: Family papers, from the family's own scans. Ministero dell'Africa Italiana, n. d'ordine 18745.

t: Birth extract of Francesca Zampiello, Arpaia
c: Comune di Arpaia, provincia di Benevento — «Estratto dell'atto di nascita n. 20». Born 27 April 1928 at Arpaia: ZAMPIELLO FRANCESCA, daughter of ZAMPIELLO ANGELO and FERRARA GIUSEPPA. A certified photocopy issued in 2003. This is the document behind the birth date the family carried, and it names both parents.
cite: Comune di Arpaia (BN), estratto dell'atto di nascita n. 20, issued 2003.

c: A hand-tinted paired portrait: Giuseppa Ferrara at the left, Angelo Zampiello at the right.

A memorial card, photographed on a crocheted cloth and rotated upright here: «ZAMPIELLO ANGELO — Nato il 31 agosto 1895 — Morto il 25 aprile 1972». It corroborates both dates from the family's own paper.

Two oval portraits mounted on card. The same photograph appears twice in the family scans, filed once under Angelo Zampiello and once under Carminantonio Falco. This archive cannot tell which couple it is, and says so rather than choosing.
Born 10 April 1897. Photographed in old age in a headscarf and crocheted shawl. The family remembers her hiding in a tree above her husband and his mistress.

t: Marriage extract — Falco and Zampiello, Arpaia, 1955
c: Comune di Arpaia — «Estratto dell'atto di matrimonio n. 1». FALCO CARMINE, born 8 June 1930, married ZAMPIELLO FRANCESCA, born 27 April 1928, on 15 January 1955. Registered at Arpaia — not, as this archive previously said, at Benevento.
cite: Comune di Arpaia (BN), estratto dell'atto di matrimonio n. 1, issued 2003.

c: Page 64 of a burial index. Four Falcos: Carmine Antonio and Filomena on page 504, Caterina and Raffaele on page 284. It was this scrap that led to the Nudgee burial registers, and from there to the Brisbane immigration files.
